label: 1. Site Selection
caption: Select the FVS Variant Location geometry which contains your project location.

label: 2. Planting Design
caption:
Estimate certified carbon units under different protocols.

*1. Planting Parameters*: Design your reforestation plan and estimate FVS results in real time.
*2. Carbon Estimates*: Estimate CO₂e (tons/acre) under different protocols.
*3. Credits*: Customize financial factors to estimate net project revenue.

label: 2. Solver
caption:
Solve for breakeven (NPV = your target, default $0).

*Breakeven Acreage*: net acres to break even, plus a financial-lever sensitivity sweep.
*Breakeven Trees-per-Acre*: the density range that breaks even, for the whole mix, one species, or every species.
